svg.text: high P2 after 31 s; trend ok
Failed points entered in issue log
What to prove on this sheet
The BMS value is read from the graphic, against an independent calibrated reference; the OEM display proves only the communication path.
Transmitters are tested at 4, 12 and 20 mA before the sensor comparison; no forced value is left in place.
F32-3 Point-to-point sheet as printed: P2P-B2-DH3-CDU07, 8 of 30 points
CDU on heater skid load 0.8 MW · permit PTW-B2-0457 · temperature tolerance ±0.3 K, flow ±3 %, pressure ±2 % of span · one failure: TCS_RetT 0.35 K
• TCS_RetT fails at 0.35 K against ±0.3 K and is entered as issue ISS-B2-0812; the retest row reads +0.02 K.
• Every reference instrument on the header has a certificate number and an expiry date later than the test date.
